historicalReference.missingRawPolicy: Lineage-only; never count toward image, pose, novelty, split support or readiness.

componentConstruction.unit: connected provenance/spatial/structural component; never frame or trajectory ID alone
componentConstruction.dualDistanceRule: Merge if either distance does not exceed its cutoff.
componentConstruction.repeatAndSamePoseRule: Repeat renders and same local pose neighborhood remain one component.

roleMaterialization.time: After an immutable readiness snapshot passes a permitted gate and before any feature fitting or training.
roleMaterialization.input: Sorted complete component IDs with label, ancestry and conservative-component identity.
roleMaterialization.algorithm: For each label, sort by SHA256(splitProtocolId + ':' + componentId). Assign at least 3 train, 1 calibration and 2 heldout_development components when scientific readiness permits. Components sharing any conservative identity or ancestry must be coalesced before assignment.
roleMaterialization.frozenArtifact: g2_p2_materialized_component_split_v1.json with exact component membership and SHA-256

engineeringDemoOnly.claims: Development diagnostic only; no independent/generalization claim; every checkpoint NON_DEPLOYABLE.

forbidden: using inaccessible raw regions as independence
placing connected trajectories or repeats in different roles
